concerns.text: Then the output dataframe contains at least 50% more columns than the input" — this threshold is arbitrary and unanchored to any FR or scientific need; it is measurable but meaningless as a pass/fail bar (adding junk columns would pass). Replace with a check that the specific named descriptor columns (mean_electronegativity, atomic_radius_variance, free_volume_proxy, etc.) exist and are non-null, which the Independent Test already states correctly.

the system gracefully stops the search and reports the best model found so far rather than crashing or hanging' is only vaguely verifiable. State the observable evidence, e.g., 'the search loop exits within [a bounded grace period] of the 2-hour budget and the output log contains the best hyperparameters and CV score found so far, with exit code 0' — the log-content check in the Independent Test is the right form; mirror it here.
